title: Orbit rollout choreographer with cost-SLO cutpoints and synthetic shadow rehearsal
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Introduces Orbit rollout choreographer: unified rollout controller that applies cost-aware SLO cutpoints, synthetic shadow rehearsal flows, and an automated rollback playbook. Backwards compatible config; enable with rollout.kind=orbit in stage policies.
description:
Context: We need a single controller that codifies staged promotions (canary/A-B), shadow rehearsals and predictable automated rollback behavior across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments. Motivation: disparate rollout implementations make cross-environment guarantees hard (different telemetry, different early-stop rules). This PR implements the "Orbit" rollout choreographer — a modular controller that composes: 1) cost-SLO cutpoints: dynamic holdpoints that evaluate both latency/error SLOs and per-token cost deltas; 2) synthetic shadow rehearsal: lightweight synthetic traffic runner that exercises new model paths with sampled inputs to detect regressions not visible in live mirrors; 3) counterfactual A/B gating: run A/B buckets with replayed sessions to estimate delta and bias-adjust results; 4) rollback playbook automation: deterministic steps for quarantine, snapshot restore, and staged traffic rewind if multiple gates fail.

Summary of changes (high-level commits):
- feat: controller core, state machine for Orbit (modular phases + holdpoint evaluation)
- feat: synthetic shadow runner + lightweight recorder and seed generator
- feat: cost-SLO evaluator and configurable thresholds per-customer/profile
- test: unit + integration harness for phased promotes and rollback scenarios
- infra: RBAC + Helm values to enable Orbit in Private installs
- docs: rollout reference and operator playbook

Commits: 6 commits (see abbreviated):
- 1a2b3c4 add orbit controller skeleton and phase transitions
- 2b3c4d5 implement holdpoint evaluator and rule engine
- 3c4d5e6 add synthetic-shadow runner and deterministic seed list
- 4d5e6f7 hook counterfactual A/B comparator and bias correction
- 5e6f7g8 add e2e smoke tests and replay harness
- 6f7g8h9 docs + helm values

Changed areas (representative):
- controller/orbit/* (new): core state machine, policy parser, phase scheduler
- telemetry/metrics/rollout_metrics.go: new metrics (orbit_holdpoint_latency, orbit_cost_delta)
- synthetic/shadow_runner.py: lightweight python harness used by tests and private installer
- tests/e2e/orbit_replay_test.go: scenario matrix for canary/AB/rollback
- helm/values/orbit.yaml: enable flags + RBAC templates
- docs/operators/orbit.md: configuration and runbook snippets

Review conversation (high level, chronological):
- Alex Chen (review): "Overall looks solid. Two asks: (1) add a deterministic seed set for synthetic shadow to avoid flaky e2e; (2) make sure cost deltas are normalized per-model-size (tokens/seq-length)."
- Priya (author): "Added deterministic seed list and normalization logic in commit 3c4d5e6; documented in orbit.md."
- Samira (review): "We should avoid automatically executing snapshot restores without human approval for enterprise tier; propose a tier-gated automaton."
- Priya: "Added tier gating in the policy parser and Helm value toggle; default behavior: auto-retain but require manual snapshot restore for enterprise (docs updated)."
- Evan (review): "CI showed a flaky replay test initially (timeout). Isolate and increase timeout for the slow path; also add a retry loop to the synthetic runner."
- Priya: "Added retries and a bounded backoff; reran CI."

CI summary:
- Initial pipeline: lint (pass), unit (pass), integration (failed: tests/e2e/orbit_replay_test.go flaky timeout)
- Rerun after fixes: all checks pass, coverage maintained.

Observability/Telemetry:
- Introduced orbit_holdpoint_duration_seconds (histogram), orbit_cost_delta_ratio (gauge), orbit_shadow_rehearsal_failures (counter).
- Console: new per-rollout dashboard panels and alert rule templates (high cost delta, repeated rehearsal failures).

Configuration notes:
- Enable by setting rollout.kind: orbit in a rollout resource or set helm values.orbit.enabled: true for cluster default.
- Policy schema additions: holdpoints[].metric, holdpoints[].cost_weight, syntheticShadow.seedList (optional), tier.autoRestore (boolean).

Migration/backwards compatibility:
- Existing rollout CRDs are compatible; Orbit controller is opt-in.
- When orbit.enabled=false, no impact to existing promote controllers.

Testing:
- Added deterministic synthetic seed fixtures and scenario table testing for: canary success, canary latency regressions, cost spike hold, synthetic rehearsal failure leading to quarantine, automatic rollback with snapshot redo.

Docs and runbook:
- docs/operators/orbit.md includes playbook: how to evacuate, manual snapshot restore steps, and incident runbook.

Edge cases and known limitations:
- Synthetic shadow runner uses a small corpus designed to approximate common request shapes; it is not a replacement for production smoke traffic and may miss rare regressions.
- Cost-SLO cutpoints rely on stable token accounting; extreme quantization combos may require calibration.

Backport and release plan:
- Merge to main -> pick into release/2025.10 for hosted rollout.
- Private installer will ship updated helm chart v1.13.2.

Merge outcome:
- PR merged via squash on 2025-10-14 after CI green and two approvals (Alex Chen, Samira Patel).

Related work: ENG-3412 (rollout harmonization), ENG-3478 (synthetic traffic harness).

Notes for operators:
- To safely evaluate Orbit on a production workload, first run syntheticShadow with replay-only mode and monitor orbit_shadow_rehearsal_failures and orbit_cost_delta_ratio for 48 hours. If stable, enable phased promote with small initial canary fraction (1%) and the default holdpoint cadence.
